αἴας: Αἴας — Ajax, Greek hero at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
αὐτὰρ: αὐτάρ — but, and then; epic conj. (= Attic δέ, ἀλλά)
αὐτὸς: αὐτός — self; masc. nom. sg., intensive with the subject: ’myself, yourself, himself’
αὔτως: αὔτως — just so, idly, without more; adv.: ’merely, to no purpose’
αὖ: αὖ — again, in turn, back; adv., shorter form of αὖτε
αὖθι: αὖθι — there, on the spot, right there; adv. (cf. αὖθις)
αὖτ: αὖτε (elided αὖτ’) — again, in turn, moreover; epic adv./conj.
βασιλεύς: βασιλεύς — king, chief; masc. nom. sg.
γ: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle (elided γ’)
γέρων: γέρων — old man; masc. nom. sg.
γαίῃ: γαῖα — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg., Ionic -ῃ (= Attic γαίᾳ)
γε: γε — at least, in fact, indeed; limiting/emphatic particle
γείνατο: γείνομαι — beget, bear (of a mother); aor. 3 sg. mid., epic, unaugmented (= ἐγείνατο)
γυναικῶν: γυνή — woman; fem. gen. pl., partitive after δῖα: ’the divine one among women’
δ: δέ (elided δ’) — and, but · also the elided suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Ἄργος δ’ ’to Argos’)
δέ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (Οὔλυμπον δέ ’to Olympus’)
δήμῳ: δῆμος — district, land, people; masc. dat. sg.
δεύτερον: δεύτερος — second; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’a second time’
δεῦρο: δεῦρο — hither, to this place; adv.
διὰ: διά — through, throughout; prep. + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis · also + acc., ’through, in (three parts)’ (διὰ τρίχα ’in three parts’)
δύω: δύο — two; numeral, epic by-form δύω, indeclinable
δὲ: δέ — and, but; connective particle · also the enclitic suffix -δε, ’to, toward’ (οἶκον δὲ ’homeward’)
δὴ: δή — indeed, now, in fact; emphatic particle
δῖα: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; fem. nom. sg., epithet of a noble woman
δῖος: δῖος — heavenly, divine, illustrious; masc. nom. sg., epithet of heroes (= fem. δῖα)
εἰδὼς: οἶδα — know; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’knowing, who knew’
εἰσήλυθον: εἰσέρχομαι — go into, enter; aor. 1 sg., epic stem -ήλυθον (= Attic εἰσῆλθον), + acc.
εἴ: εἰ — if, whether; accented εἴ before an enclitic (εἴ κεν, εἴ ποτε, εἴ περ)
εἶδος: εἶδος — form, look, beauty; neut. acc. sg. (accusative of respect): ’in beauty’ · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’form, good looks’ (τό τε εἶδος ’and the looks’)
εὐρὺ: εὐρύς — wide, broad; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’widely’ (εὐρὺ κρείων ’wide-ruling’)
ηὔδα: αὐδάω — speak, say; impf. 3 sg., augmented (αὐ- → ηὐ-)
θ: τε (elided and aspirated θ’ before a rough breathing) — and; connective particle
θεὸς: θεός — god; masc. nom. sg., subject: ’the god’ (common gender; may also name a goddess)
κακὸς: κακός — bad, base, cowardly; masc. nom. sg., predicate: ’base’
καλλιγύναικα: καλλιγύναιξ — with fair women; adj. (2-term.), fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἑλλάδα · also fem. acc. sg., agreeing with Ἀχαιΐδα ’Achaea’
καρπὸν: καρπός — fruit, crop, harvest; masc. acc. sg.
κατὰ: κατά — down, throughout, along; + acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (κατὰ … ἔκηα ’burned up’) · also + acc. in κατὰ μοῖραν ’according to what is fitting’ · also + acc. of purpose, ’for’ (κατὰ δαῖτα ’for a feast’) · also + acc. of respect, ’in’ (κατὰ θυμόν ’in heart’) · also + acc., distributive: ’by’ (κατὰ φῦλα ’by tribes’) · also + acc. of place: ’in, among’ (κατὰ ὑσμίνας ’in the battles’) · also κατὰ σφέας ’by themselves, apart’
κε: κε(ν) — epic particle marking a conditioned or potential action (= Attic ἄν); with the subj. in purpose and general clauses · also + subj. in a temporal or conditional clause: ’whenever’, ’if’ · also + fut. indic. in a main clause: ’shall’ (κε μελήσεται ’will concern’) · also + opt., potential: ’would’ (τώ κε … ἠμύσειε ’then would collapse’)
κεν: κε(ν) — epic particle (= Attic ἄν); with the opt., potential: ’might, would’; with the subj. in conditions after εἰ, αἰ · also + subj. or fut. indic. in a main or relative clause: ’shall’ (’I shall take’; ’to whom I come’) · also + subj. in a general relative clause: ’whatever’ (ὅττί κεν εἴπῃς) · also with a past indic., contrary to fact: ’would have’ (ἔνθά κεν … ἐτύχθη) · also with an impf. indic., past potential: ’would be’ (κεν … κέρδιον ἦεν ’it would be better’)
κεφαλήν: κεφαλή — head; fem. acc. sg., acc. of respect: ’in the head’
κεφαλῇ: κεφαλή — head; fem. dat. sg., of the means: ’with a (nod of the) head’ · also dative of measure: ’by a head’ (κεφαλῇ … μείζονες ’taller by a head’)
κοσμήτορε: κοσμήτωρ — marshaller, commander (from κοσμέω ’set in order’); masc. acc. dual
κοῦροι: κοῦρος — young man, boy; masc. nom. pl. · also masc. voc. pl., in address: ’youths!’ (κοῦροι Ἀχαιῶν ’youths of the Achaeans’)
κρείων: κρείων — ruling, lord, sovereign; masc. nom. sg., epithet of kings (εὐρὺ κρείων ’wide-ruling’)
κρητῶν: Κρῆτες — the Cretans; masc. gen. pl.
κτήμαθ: κτῆμα — possession, piece of property; neut. acc. pl., elided and aspirated (κτήμαθ’ = κτήματα)
λαοὺς: λαός — people, folk, host; masc. acc. pl. (epic; Attic λεώς)
λαῶν: λαός — people, host; masc. gen. pl.: ’of the people’
μ: ἐγώ — I; encl. acc. sg., elided (μ’ = με): ’me’ · also = dat. μοι, elided before a vowel, with a dat. participle: ’to me’ (ἥ μ’ οἴῳ ἔρροντι συνήντετο, συναντάω + dat.)
μάλα: μάλα — very, very much, exceedingly; adv.
μέγα: μέγας — great, huge; neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’greatly’ (μέγα νήπιοι ’greatly foolish’)
μέγας: μέγας — great, big; masc. nom. sg.
μέν: μέν — on the one hand; truly; particle, often answered by δέ; acute before an enclitic; ἦ μέν ’truly’ in oaths · also asseverative, = μήν ’surely, truly’ (οὐ μέν πως ’surely not in any way’)
μακρῇς: μακρός — long, tall; fem. dat. pl., epic -ῇς (= Attic μακραῖς)
μείων: μείων — smaller, less (comparative of μικρός); masc. nom. sg.
μεγάροισι: μέγαρον — hall; neut. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
μενέλαος: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, king of Sparta, brother of Agamemnon; masc. nom. sg.
μενελάῳ: Μενέλαος — Menelaus, brother of Agamemnon; masc. dat. sg.
μετὰ: μετά — among, with, after; + dat./acc./gen. · also an adverb, ’among them’, or a preverb in tmesis
μιν: μιν — him, her, it; epic encl. acc. pron. (= Attic αὐτόν/αὐτήν/αὐτό)
μοί: ἐγώ — I; dat. sg., accented μοί before the enclitic that follows: ’to me, for me’
μοι: ἐγώ — I; encl. dat. sg.: ’to me, for me’
μύθους: μῦθος — word, speech, thing said; masc. acc. pl.
μὲν: μέν — on the one hand; particle, often answered by δέ · also asseverative, = μήν ’truly, indeed’: οὐ μὲν δή ’surely not’
νημερτὲς: νημερτής — unerring, infallible; neut. acc. sg. used adverbially: ’unerringly, truly’
νικήσαντι: νικάω — win, conquer; aor. part. act. masc. dat. sg.: ’to the one who has won’
νύ: νυ — now, then; weak encl. particle
οἱ: οἱ — encl. dat. sg. pron. ’to/for him, her’ · also ὁ, ἡ, τό, masc. nom. pl. ’they’
οἳ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also relative ὅς, masc. nom. pl., ’who’
οἵ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., masc. nom. pl. · also demonstrative, with γε: ’they’ (οἵ γ’ ἀθέριζον)
οὐ: οὐ — not; neg. adv. · also in a question expecting the answer ’yes’ (οὐ γὰρ δὴ … ἐβούλευσας; ’did you not devise …?’)
οὐδ: οὐδέ (elided οὐδ’) — and not, nor, not even
οὐκ: οὐ — not; neg. adv., form before a vowel with smooth breathing (οὐχ before a rough breathing)
οὔτ: οὔτε (elided οὔτ’) — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.
οὔτε: οὔτε — nor, and not; correlative negative conj.: ’neither … nor’
οὕς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. acc. pl., object of ἔπασχον: ’which (struggles)’
οὗτος: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg.: ’this one’
πάντας: πᾶς — all, every; masc. acc. pl.
παρ: παρά (elided παρ’) — beside, by; + acc.: ’along, beside’ (παρ’ αὐτὸν) · also + gen., ’from beside’ (παρ’ Εὐρύτου ’from Eurytus’) · also prep. + dat.: ’beside’ (παρ’ ἅρμασιν ’beside the chariots’)
παῖδά: παῖς — child, daughter; fem. acc. sg., accented before enclitic τε: ’daughter’
περ: περ — even, though; enclitic particle, concessive or intensive; εἴ περ ’even if’
πιστὰ: πιστός — trusty, faithful; neut. acc. pl., attributive: ὅρκια πιστά ’faithful oaths’
πλείστους: πολύς — much, many; superl. πλεῖστος, masc. acc. pl.: ’the most’
πολλοὶ: πολύς — much, many; masc. nom. pl.
πολύμητις: πολύμητις — of many counsels, very wily, epithet of Odysseus (μῆτις ’cunning intelligence’); masc. nom. sg.
ποντοπόροισι: ποντοπόρος — sea-crossing, sea-faring; adj. of two endings, fem. dat. pl., epic -οισι (= Attic -οις)
ποτ: ποτέ — once, at some time, ever; enclitic adv., elided (ποτ’ = ποτέ)
πουλυβοτείρῃ: πολυβότειρα — much-nourishing, giving much pasture; fem. dat. sg., epic πουλυ- and -ῃ (= Attic πολυβοτείρᾳ), epithet of the earth
πρίαμος: Πρίαμος — Priam, king of Troy; masc. nom. sg.
πὰρ: παρά (apocope πάρ, grave before another word) — beside, alongside; prep. + dat.: ’beside’ · also prep. + acc., ’beside’ (πὰρ ποταμὸν ’beside the river’) · also prep. + gen., ’from beside’ (πὰρ Διὸς ’from Zeus’)
πᾶσιν: πᾶς — all, every; masc./neut. dat. pl. (ν-movable)
σεῦ: σύ — you; gen. sg., epic σεῦ (= Attic σοῦ)
σκῆπτρον: σκῆπτρον — staff, sceptre (badge of the right to speak); neut. acc. sg.
στίχας: στίξ — row, rank, line (of men); fem. acc. pl.

σῷ: σός — your (sg.); masc. dat. sg., with πατρί
τ: τε (elided τ’) — and; ’epic τε’ also marks a general truth; in τ’ ἄρ with a question, ’then’
τά: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. pl., ’those things’; accented before an enclitic · also relative, neut. nom. pl.: ’which’ (τά τ’ αἰδῶ ἀμφικαλύπτει ’which cover the shame’) · also neut. nom. pl. with a noun, article-like: ’the’ (τά τε δῶρ’ Ἀφροδίτης ’and the gifts of Aphrodite’)
τέ: τε — and; enclitic connective, accented τέ before the enclitic μιν
τέκος: τέκος — child, offspring; neut. voc. sg.
τίς: τίς, τί — who? what?; interrog. pron., masc./fem. nom. sg. · also indefinite τις after ὅς, written τίς: ’anyone, someone’ (ὅς τίς σφιν … ἡγήσαιτο ’anyone to lead them’) · also indefinite, written τίς: ’someone, one’ (ὡς δ’ ὅτε τίς τε δράκοντα ἰδών ’as when someone, seeing a snake’)
ταμόντες: τάμνω (τέμνω) — cut; aor. part. masc. nom. pl., epic τάμνω (= Attic τεμόντες): ὅρκια ταμόντες ’cutting a sworn pact’
τε: τε — and, both...and; enclitic connective; also ’epic τε’ marking a standing general truth in relative clauses
τεύχεα: τεῦχος — armor, gear; neut. acc. pl., epic uncontracted -εα (= Attic τεύχη)
τιν: τις, τι — someone, something; masc. acc. sg., elided (τιν’ = τινα)

τοι: σύ — you (sg.); encl. dat. sg.: ’to/for you’ · also τοι, the affirming particle: ’you know, indeed’ (esp. in ἦ τοι, οὔ τοι); the two are not always easy to keep apart
τοὶ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. pl., ’they’ · also the particle τοι, as in τοὶ γάρ (= τοιγάρ) ’so then, therefore’
τοὺς: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. pl. ’them’
τοῖσιν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. dat. pl. ’with them’ · also masc. dat. pl., ’among them, to them’ (τοῖσιν … μετέφη ’spoke among them’)
τοῦτο: οὗτος, αὕτη, τοῦτο — this; neut. acc. sg., object of ἐρέουσα · also neut. nom. sg., subject: ’this’ (τοῦτο … τέκμωρ ’this is the sign’)
τροίην: Τροίη — Troy; fem. acc. sg. (Attic Τροία)
τρώεσσιν: Τρῶες — Trojans; masc. dat. pl., epic -εσσιν (= Attic Τρωσί)
τρώων: Τρῶες — the Trojans; masc. gen. pl.
τόνδε: ὅδε — this, this one; demonstrative pron., masc. acc. sg.: ’this man’
τότ: τότε — then, at that time; adv., elided (τότ’ = τότε)
τότε: τότε — then, at that time; adv.
τώ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, they two’ (τώ γε) · also dual relative: ’the two who’ (τώ οἱ ἔσαν κήρυκε ’the two who were his heralds’) · also adverb (= Attic τῷ), ’therefore, so’
τὰρ: ἄρα — then, so; τὰρ is taken as τε + ἄρα run together (compare τίς τ’ ἄρ), after interrogative τίς: ’who then?’
τὴν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); fem. acc. sg.: ’her’ · also relative, fem. acc. sg.: ’which’ (τὴν πρῶτον ἐπηπείλησ’ ’which he first threatened’)
τὸ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); neut. nom./acc. sg., ’this, that’ · also relative, neut. nom. sg.: ’which’ (σκῆπτρον, τὸ … οὔ ποτε φύλλα φύσει) · also neut. acc. sg. with a noun, article-like: ’the, that’ (τὸ Πελασγικὸν Ἄργος ’the Pelasgian Argos’)
τὸν: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. acc. sg., ’him’; with a noun, ’that’ · also relative, ’whom’
τὼ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); dual nom.: ’the two of them, those two’ · also dual acc.: ’those two’ (τὼ γὰρ νεικείεσκε) · also τὼ = τῷ, adv.: ’therefore, so’ (τὼ οὐκ ἂν … ἀγορεύοις) · also dual relative: ’whom’
τῷ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc./neut. dat. sg., ’to him’ · also adverbial, ’therefore’ · also neut., ’on it’ (τῷ … ἐρεισάμενος ’leaning on it’) · also with a noun, ’that, the’ (ἤματι τῷ ’on that day’; τῷ δεκάτῳ ’in the tenth’)
φάτο: φημί — say, speak; impf. 3 sg. mid., unaugmented (= ἔφατο)
φέρον: φέρω — carry, bear; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= Attic ἔφερον): ’were carrying’
φίλε: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. voc. sg.
φίλον: φίλος — dear, one’s own; masc. acc. sg. · also neut. nom./acc. sg. · also neut. voc. sg., agreeing with τέκος: ’dear (child)’
φίλῃ: φίλος — dear, beloved; fem. dat. sg.
φιλότητα: φιλότης — friendship, love, kindness; fem. acc. sg.
φρύγας: Φρύγες — the Phrygians; masc. acc. pl.
φώνησέν: φωνέω — speak, utter; aor. 3 sg., ν-movable, accented before the enclitic τε
χαλκοχιτώνων: χαλκοχίτων — bronze-shirted, with bronze tunics; masc. gen. pl.
χθονὶ: χθών — earth, ground; fem. dat. sg.
ἀγαθὸν: ἀγαθός — good; neut. nom. sg., predicate: ’(not) good’
ἀγαθὸς: ἀγαθός — good, brave, noble; adj., masc. nom. sg.
ἀγαμέμνων: Ἀγαμέμνων — Agamemnon, king of Mycenae, leader of the Achaeans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἀγόρευε: ἀγορεύω — speak, declare; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἠγόρευε)
ἀλέξανδρος: Ἀλέξανδρος — Alexander, the other name of Paris, son of Priam; masc. nom. sg.
ἀλλ: ἀλλά (elided ἀλλ’) — but; well then · also ’except’: ’but only’ (ἀλλ’ οἶοι ’except us two’)
ἀμφὶ: ἀμφί — on both sides, around; adv. and preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἀμφὶ … ἴαχε = ἀμφίαχε ’roared around’) · also prep. + acc., ’around’ (ἀμφὶ ῥέεθρα ’around the streams’) · also prep. + dat. or φιν-case, ’about’ (ἀμφὶ στήθεσφιν ’about the chest’)
ἀνέρας: ἀνήρ — man; masc. acc. pl., epic ἀνέρας (= Attic ἄνδρας)
ἀντήνωρ: Ἀντήνωρ — Antenor, one of the Trojan elders; masc. nom. sg.
ἀντίον: ἀντίον — opposite, face to face; adv. or prep. + gen.: ’in opposition to, to the face of’
ἀνὰ: ἀνά — up along, throughout; + acc. (ἀνὰ στρατόν ’throughout the army’) · + dat., ’upon’ (ἀνὰ σκήπτρῳ ’upon a sceptre’) · also adv./preverb in tmesis: ’up, aboard’ (ἀνὰ … εἷσεν ’set aboard’) · also + acc. in ἀνὰ στόμ’ ἔχων ’having on your lips, going on about’
ἀργείων: Ἀργεῖοι — the Argives, i.e. the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἀρηΐφιλος: ἀρηΐφιλος — dear to Ares, war-loving; adj. (2-term.), masc. nom. sg., epithet of Menelaus
ἀτρεΐδαο: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus, i.e. Agamemnon; gen. sg., epic (-αο = Attic -ου)
ἀτρεΐδη: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus; masc. voc. sg.
ἀτρεΐδης: Ἀτρεΐδης — son of Atreus (patronymic); masc. nom. sg.
ἀχαιΐδα: Ἀχαιΐς — Achaean; adj. of land, fem. acc. sg. · also used as a noun: ’Achaea’, the Achaean land (Ἀχαιΐδα καλλιγύναικα ’Achaea of the fair women’)
ἀχαιοί: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. nom. pl.
ἀχαιούς: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; masc. acc. pl.
ἀχαιὸς: Ἀχαιός — Achaean, Greek; masc. nom. sg., in apposition to ἀνήρ: ’an Achaean (man)’
ἀχαιῶν: Ἀχαιοί — the Achaeans, the Greeks; gen. pl.
ἂν: ἀνά — up, aboard; prep./preverb, with apocope ἂν before δ’; in tmesis (ἂν … βήσομεν ’put aboard’) · also modal particle ἄν (= κεν) written ἂν: with the opt., potential: ’would’; with the subj. after εὖτ’: ’whenever’ · also with ὡς + subj.: ’in the way that’ (ὡς ἂν ἐγὼ εἴπω ’as I may say’) · also modal particle with the subj. after ὅτ’: ’whenever’ (ὅτ’ ἂν … γένωνται ’whenever they come to be’) · also modal particle with a fut. or short-vowel subj.: ’could’ (οὐκ ἂν … μυθήσομαι ’I could not tell’) · also εἴ περ ἂν + opt., ’even if … should’ · also εἴ περ ἂν + subj., ’even if … ever’ (εἴ περ ἂν αὐτὸν σεύωνται ’even if they set upon him’)
ἄγε: ἄγε — come now!; interjectional imper. of ἄγω, 2 sg. · also ἄγω — lead; impf. 3 sg., unaugmented (= ἦγε): ’led’ · also ἄγω — lead; pres. imper. 2 sg.: ’lead’ (μή μ’ ἄγε κεῖσ’ ’do not lead me there’)
ἄλλοι: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. pl.
ἄλλος: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. nom. sg.: ’another, anyone else’
ἄλλους: ἄλλος — other, another; masc. acc. pl.
ἄμφω: ἄμφω — both; dual adj./pron., of two persons: ’both (of them)’
ἄρ: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, short form ἄρ (elided ἄρ’ before a vowel)
ἄργος: Ἄργος — Argos, the Argive land (Greece); neut. nom./acc. sg. · also the Pelasgian Argos, a district of northern Greece; neut. acc. sg.
ἄριστοι: ἄριστος — best; superl. of ἀγαθός, masc. nom. pl.
ἄστυ: ἄστυ — town, city; neut. acc. sg.
ἅ: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ — who, which; relative pron., neut. nom./acc. pl.: ’which things’
ἐγένοντο: γίγνομαι — become, be born; aor. 3 pl. mid.: ’were born’
ἐγχείῃσι: ἐγχείη — spear (= ἔγχος); fem. dat. pl., epic -ῃσι (= Attic -αις), instrumental
ἐγὼν: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg., form used before a vowel
ἐκ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as adverb or preverb in tmesis, no case expressed: ’out’ (ἐκ δ’ ἔβαν ’and out they stepped’)
ἐν: ἐν — in, on, among; + dat.; also used as an adverb, ’in it, there’ · also as preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐν … βάλῃ = ἐμβάλῃ ’cast in’; ἐν … χεῦον = ἔγχεον ’pour in’)
ἐνὶ: ἐν (epic ἐνί) — in, on, among; + dat. · also adverb or preverb, no case: ’therein’ (ἔνθ’ ἐνὶ πέπλοι ... βεβλήατο ’therein coverlets were laid’) · also + gen., of a person’s house: ’in the house of’ (ἐνὶ Κίρκης ’in Circe’s house’)
ἐξ: ἐκ (ἐξ before a vowel) — out of, from; + gen. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb (ἐξ … ἕντο = ἐξέντο, from ἐξίημι ’send out, put away (desire)’)
ἐοικώς: ἔοικα — be like, resemble, seem; perf. part. masc. nom. sg.: ’resembling, looking like’
ἐπέεσσιν: ἔπος — word; neut. dat. pl., epic -εσσι(ν) (= Attic ἔπεσι)
ἐπὶ: ἐπί — on, upon, to, against; + dat./acc./gen.; also a preverb in tmesis (ἐπὶ … ἔτελλε = ἐπέτελλε) · also + dat., ’in aid of, on behalf of’ (ἐπὶ Τρώεσσιν ἀρῆξαι ’to help the Trojans’) · also + acc. of duration, ’for’ (ἐπὶ χρόνον ’for a time’) · also + acc. of extent, ’over, along’ (ἐπὶ νῶτον ’along the back’) · also + acc. of the thing aimed at, ’for’ (ἐπὶ τεύχεα ’for the armour’)
ἐρέειν: ἐρέω (= εἴρω/λέγω) — say, tell, speak; fut. inf., epic uncontracted -έειν (= Attic ἐρεῖν)
ἐρέω: ἐρέω — say, tell, declare; fut. 1 sg. (epic fut. of εἶπον, = Attic ἐρῶ); in tmesis with ἐκ, ἐξερέω ’speak out plainly’
ἐριβώλακα: ἐρίβωλαξ — of rich soil, with large clods; fem. acc. sg., with Λάρισαν · also fem. acc. sg., epithet of Troy (Τροίην ἐριβώλακα)
ἐς: εἰς (epic ἐς) — into, to; + acc. · also as a preverb in tmesis, standing apart from its verb with no case expressed (ἐς … ἦλθον = εἰσῆλθον ’came in’)
ἐσσι: εἰμί — be; pres. 2 sg., epic (= Attic εἶ)
ἐστί: εἰμί — be; pres. 3 sg.; with a perf. part., periphrastic perfect: ’has been, is done’
ἐὼν: εἰμί — be; pres. part. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ὤν)
ἐῢ: ἐΰς — good; neut. ἐῢ used as adv. ’well’ (= εὖ)
ἑλίκωπες: ἑλίκωψ — quick-eyed (or with rolling eyes; meaning uncertain), epithet of the Achaeans; masc. nom. pl.
ἑτέρωθεν: ἑτέρωθεν — from the other side; adv. with suffix -θεν
ἔβη: βαίνω — go, walk, step; aor. 3 sg., root aorist (= ἔβη): ’went’
ἔγωγε: ἐγώ — I; nom. sg. with the strengthening particle -γε: ’I for my part’
ἔειπες: εἶπον — say, speak; aor. 2 sg., epic uncontracted, augment ἐ- kept (ἔειπες = εἶπες)
ἔην: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic (= Attic ἦν)
ἔμμεναι: εἰμί — be; pres. inf., epic (= Attic εἶναι)
ἔνθα: ἔνθα — there, then; adverb of place or time · also relative, ’where’ (ἔνθα πάρος κοιμᾶθ’ ’where he used to sleep’) · also ἔνθα καὶ ἔνθα ’hither and thither, this way and that’
ἔξοχος: ἔξοχος — standing out, pre-eminent (+ partitive gen.); adj. (2 endings), masc. nom. sg.
ἔπεα: ἔπος — word, speech; neut. nom./acc. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ἔπη)
ἔπειθ: ἔπειτα — then, thereafter; adv., elided (ἔπειθ’ = ἔπειτα before a rough breathing)
ἔπειτ: ἔπειτα (elided ἔπειτ’) — then, next, after that
ἔπος: ἔπος — word, speech, thing said; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἔχον: ἔχω — have, hold; impf. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶχον): ’held’
ἕνεκ: ἕνεκα — because of, for the sake of; prep. + gen., elided (ἕνεκ’ = ἕνεκα)
ἕποντο: ἕπομαι — follow, accompany; impf. 3 pl. mid., augmented (ἕποντο = εἵποντο)
ἕρκος: ἕρκος — fence, barrier, bulwark; neut. nom./acc. sg.
ἠΰς: ἠΰς — good, noble, brave; adj., masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἀγαθός)
ἠδὲ: ἠδέ — and; epic conj. (τε … ἠδέ ’both … and’)
ἠμείβετ: ἀμείβω — exchange; mid. answer, reply; impf. 3 sg. mid., elided (ἠμείβετ’ = ἠμείβετο)
ἡμετέρῳ: ἡμέτερος — our, ours; masc./neut. dat. sg.
ἢ: ἤ — or; disjunctive conj.; ἢ … ἤ ’either … or’ · also ’than’ after a comparative · also introducing the first alternative of an indirect question: ’whether’ (ἢ ἐτεὸν … ἦε ’whether truly … or’)
ἤδη: ἤδη — now, already, at once; adv.
ἤματι: ἦμαρ — day; neut. dat. sg., epic ἤματι
ἤτοι: ἤτοι (also printed ἦ τοι) — truly, surely; affirming particle, often barely translatable at the head of a formula
ἦ: ἦ — truly, surely; affirming particle; ἦ μέν in oaths · also an interrogative particle · also ἠμί — say; impf. 3 sg. ἦ ’he said’, in ἦ καί, ἦ ῥα · also ἦ = ἤ, ’or’ (εἰ … ἦ ’whether … or’)
ἦεν: εἰμί — be; impf. 3 sg., epic ἦεν (= Attic ἦν)
ἦλθον: ἔρχομαι — go, come; aor. 1 sg. (the same ending serves 3 pl.): ’I came’
ἰδομενεὺς: Ἰδομενεύς — Idomeneus, king of Crete, leader of the Cretans at Troy; masc. nom. sg.
ἰδὲ: ἰδέ — and; epic conj. (= Attic καί)
ἰδὼν: ὁράω (aor. stem ἰδ-) — see; aor. part. act. masc. nom. sg., epic (= Attic ἰδών): ’seeing, looking’
ἱπποδάμων: ἱππόδαμος — horse-taming; adj., masc. gen. pl.
ἱππόβοτον: ἱππόβοτος — horse-feeding, horse-pasturing; neut. acc. sg., with Ἄργος
ἴδον: ὁράω — see; aor. 1 sg., unaugmented, from the root of εἶδον (= εἶδον): ’I saw’ · also aor. 3 pl., unaugmented (= εἶδον): ’they saw’
ἵν: ἵνα — where; relative adv. of place, elided (ἵν’ = ἵνα; = Attic οὗ) · also conj. ’so that’
ὀδυσσεύς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
ὀδυσσεὺς: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus, king of Ithaca; masc. nom. sg.
ὀδυσῆα: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; acc. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆα)
ὀδυσῆος: Ὀδυσσεύς — Odysseus; gen. sg. (single-σ metrical variant of Ὀδυσσῆος)
ὀνείδεα: ὄνειδος — reproach, taunt, blame; neut. nom. pl., epic uncontracted (= Attic ὀνείδη) · also neut. acc. pl., object: ’reproaches’ (λέγ’ ὀνείδεα ’spoke reproaches’)
ὀπίσσω: ὀπίσσω — behind, backward, afterwards; adv. (= ὀπίσω)
ὁ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it; that (in Homer a pronoun; later the article); masc. nom. sg.
ὁππότε: ὁππότε — when; temporal conj., epic doubled π (= ὁπότε)
ὃ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., printed with a grave accent in some editions · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, neut. nom./acc. sg., ’which’ · also neut. nom. sg. demonstrative: ’this’ (ὃ δέ τοι … ὅρκος ’and this shall be your oath’) · also relative ὅς, ἥ, ὅ, masc. nom. sg.: ’who’ (ὃ σφῶϊ προΐει ’who sent you’) · also masc. nom. sg. in the correlative ὃ μὲν … ὃ δέ: ’the one … the other’
ὃς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅν (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg. · also possessive ὅς, ἥ, ὅν: his own, her own (masc. nom. sg.) · also plain demonstrative, ’he’ (ὃς γὰρ δεύτατος ἦλθεν), not a relative
ὄπα: ὄψ (gen. ὀπός) — voice; fem. acc. sg., epic ὄπα
ὅ: ὁ, ἡ, τό — he, she, it (in Homer a pronoun); masc. nom. sg., with γε ’he’ · also relative neut. ’which’; ὅ τι ’whatever, why’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of seeing: ’that’ · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of emotion: ’that, because’ (χωόμενος ὅ τ’ … ’angry that …’) · also neut. acc. sg. as a conjunction after a verb of knowing: ’that’ (ὅ τ’ ἄριστον … οὐδὲν ἔτισεν) · also εἰς ὅ (κεν) + subj., ’until’ (εἰς ὅ κεν … ἕλωμεν ’until we take’) · also masc. nom. sg. ’he’ without γε (ὅ σφιν ’he … to them’)
ὅδ: ὅδε — this, this here; demonstrative pron., masc. nom. sg., elided (ὅδ’ = ὅδε)
ὅρκια: ὅρκιον — oath, sworn pledge; neut. acc. pl.: ὅρκια τάμνειν ’to swear a pact’ (lit. cut victims)
ὅς: ὅς, ἥ, ὅ (relative) — who, which; masc. nom. sg., accented before an enclitic · also ὅς τις as an indirect interrogative: ’who’ (ὅς τις ὅδ’ ἐστίν ’who this is’)
ὅσοι: ὅσος — as much/many as; masc. nom. pl.
ὑπαὶ: ὑπαί — under; epic lengthened form of ὑπό; prep. + acc.
ὡς: ὡς — as, how, that; conj. (unaccented) introducing a fact: ’that’ · also causal: ’since, seeing that’ · also temporal, ’when’ (ὡς ἴδον ’when they saw’) · also final, ’so that’ (+ subj./opt.): ὡς φρήτρη … ἀρήγῃ ’so that clan may help clan’
ὣς: ὥς — thus, so; adverb (accented, distinct from unaccented ὡς ’as’; = Attic οὕτως); ὣς ἔφατ’ ’so he spoke’ · also ὣς = ὡς, ’like, as’ after its noun (κακὸν ὣς ’like a coward’)
ὤμοισιν: ὦμος — shoulder; masc. dat. pl., epic -οισιν (= Attic -οις)
ῥά: ἄρα — then, so, as it seems; inferential particle, weak enclitic form ῥα, accented ῥά
ῥα: ἄρα — then, so; weak enclitic form ῥα (used after a vowel)
